svg.title: NetTango mark
svg.desc: Grid: 1024 canvas, 16 x 16 units of 64 (1 unit = 1 px at 16, 2 at 32, 64 at 1024). Safe area: 1 unit inset, 64 to 960. Mark bounds: x 64 to 960 (14 units), y 128 to 896 (12 units). Block body: x 192 to 960, y 128 to 896, corner radius 64 (1 unit). Tab (left) and notch (right): 2 units deep, 6 units tall (y 320 to 704), end radius 128. Tab and notch share one shape, so two marks interlock. Play glyph: triangle x 384 to 768, y 320 to 704, corner radius 32; its centroid (x 512) sits on the mark's area centroid, which is the optical center. Colours: block #E91400 (--color-block-red), glyph #FFFFFF. Surface: #FFFFFF behind opaque exports such as the touch icon. The surface and keylines groups are hidden; the icon script turns them on per export.
